description.en: Send local files to WeChat from inside DeepSeek Harness. Ships a left-sidebar panel, the wechat_send_file model tool and a send button on every DSH deliverable card, defaulting to the File Transfer chat. The run reads the open chat with Windows OCR and refuses to paste unless the header matches the target, and when several conversations share a display name it stops with chat-ambiguous instead of guessing. WeChat 4 exposes no stable conversation id and OCR can misread, so this reduces but cannot guarantee against a wrong recipient; autoSend stays off by default so files are staged for review. Files are picked through WeChat's own file dialog because 4.1.15.13 ignores clipboard file pastes; results are confirmed by file name plus size label, or by a structural change of the composer and message pane for images. If WeChat is not running the plugin starts it and clicks 进入微信; a QR-only screen is reported, not guessed. Windows only; MIT.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里把本地文件发到微信，默认目标是「文件传输助手」。提供左侧栏面板、wechat_send_file 模型工具，以及每张 DSH 产物卡片上的「发微信」按钮。发送按两步处理：先读窗口标题，不是目标聊天就拒绝粘贴；会话列表里出现多个同名聊天时返回 chat-ambiguous 并中止，不做猜测。由于微信 4.x 不提供稳定会话 ID、OCR 也可能误识别，这能降低但无法绝对避免发错会话，因此默认不自动发送（autoSend=false），先把文件放进输入框由人确认。文件通过微信自己的「选择文件」对话框选取，因为微信 4.1.15.13 不认剪贴板里的文件；发送结果按文件名加大小标签确认，图片则按输入框与聊天区的结构变化确认。微信没在运行时会自动拉起并点「进入微信」；只有二维码时如实报告。仅支持 Windows，MIT。
